newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end sharply down on removal of limit.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end sharply down on removal of limit.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed sharply down as many shares fell steeply after the withdrawal of the 10 percent price fluctuation limit, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 172.05 points or 8.76 percent to 1,790.26. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. Of 102 traded issues 46 gained and 52 lost.

"May of the stocks faced a deep correction after the withdrawal of the price limit for 43 issues that gained sharply in euphoric trading late last year and had not been traded for more than one month," said a broker. Monno Jutex Industries lost 3,580 taka to 5,000 and Shine Pukur fell 455 to 224.
